clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Orokk Omosh seeks someone to carry on his family's forge craft. With no heirs, he asks an aspiring smith to prove a sure hand with bronze before sharing his knowledge.

Orokk Omosh works the anvils of Orgrimmar under the weight of his family's past. For twenty generations, the Omosh line has shaped ore into weapons and armor for the Horde. Orokk has no kin and cannot sire children, and he sees himself as a failure to that line. With the family craft at risk of ending, he sets bloodline pride aside and seeks an apprentice to carry its smithing traditions forward.

Orokk will not share his secrets with an untested smith. He asks for two patterned bronze bracers, two bronze greatswords, and two sharp beast claws as proof of basic skill at the anvil. To him, blacksmithing is no idle luxury: its highest honor is armor and steel stained with enemy blood. Meeting his demands may persuade the old smith that the Omosh legacy can live on through an apprentice, and earn a chance to learn more of the craft.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Twenty generations of Omosh have held this hammer, friend. A hundred thousand tons of metal we have molded. Tragically, it all ends at Orokk, failure of the Omosh: Without kin and incapable of producing offspring.
I cannot let the secret recipes of Omosh die with me! Someone must continue the legacy, Omosh or not!
Prove to Orokk you are capable, friend. Bring for Orokk the following: Two patterned bronze bracers, two bronze greatswords, and two sharp claws. Bring them for Orokk and we shall continue.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The bloodline will fade but perhaps the legend of Omosh will continue!
You have proven that you are a blacksmith, friend. For the blacksmith the reward is the satisfaction of seeing their weapons and armors coated in the blood of their enemies!
May the breastplates you create for the generations ahead be drenched in the blood of your enemies!
